prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production UI sprite atlas for the Japanese arcade game Cookie Link, not a mockup.
Create ONE premium confectionery interface sprite sheet, portrait 1024 x 1536 pixels, transparent RGBA background. Four separate horizontal ornaments stacked vertically in EXACTLY four equal height rows. Each row contains exactly one isolated straight-on wide UI plaque, centered, with generous transparent spacing above and below. All four plaques are roughly 930 pixels wide and 240 pixels high. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no watermark anywhere.
Style: lovingly detailed glossy 3D painted Japanese medal arcade sweets fantasy, warm honey gold gilding, real baked shortbread texture, piping of ivory whipped cream, strawberry jam jewel accents. Crisp fine material detail, polished highlights and realistic soft sculpted shadows. Match a luxury pastry shop arcade machine. Absolutely no flat vector icons or simple generic gradients.
ROW 1: dramatic headline cartouche. A wide deep raspberry-jam ribbon with a dark chocolate inset center suitable for cream/gold text to be overlaid by software, double caramel gold bevel trim, tiny raised biscuit flourishes at ends, a little piped cream and red jam gem above the exact middle. Keep central 65% clean and dark for dynamic heading.
ROW 2: normal payout row plaque. Thin softly scalloped butter biscuit outer edges, delicate gold piping. Left 38% a raspberry jam enamel lozenge with dark red smooth center; right 62% smooth pale custard enamel blank area for large live gold numbers. Straight rectangular overall silhouette, small accents at outer ends, no decoration over center.
ROW 3: selected winning payout row plaque. Same overall shape and division as row 2, but left strawberry-red jewel enamel, especially luminous thick gold piping, right clear pale lemon custard; jewel star clasps only at outer ends. Looks visibly valuable, not blurry glowing.
ROW 4: footer plaque. Wide caramel ribbon and pale ivory center framed by a pair of beautiful golden butter cookies and a tiny cream dollop at the two ends. Middle 65% open and light for a software label, fine gold scalloped trim.
Transparent outside each plaque, not a checkerboard painted into the image. Keep all sprite silhouettes fully in their own quarter of the sheet, no overlaps, no cropping. Front view, no perspective skew. Entire image is these four reusable UI sprites only.
